529-955-4186-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

277-5531-5694-7487-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-5531-5694-7487-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-5531-5694-7487-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Zealous Lorecaster and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1594-2781-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-3043-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-5434.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

412-3081-3817-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2438-4681-5170-7452.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2445-2921-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

3536-5078-6918.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

2653-2893-6168-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3685-6747-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
3685-6747-6797.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 3.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

874-2854-4574-6900.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
874-2854-4574-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
874-2854-4574-6900.description:
Cast Delif's Cone either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

678-2034-2060-6759.description:
Cast Broodguard Elite for its warp cost by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Broodguard Elite, adding {C}{C}.
When Broodguard Elite dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Broodguard Elite trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Broodguard Elite from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
678-2034-2060-6759.notes: You can cast Broodguard Elite for larger amounts of mana for infinite +1/+1 counters if mana allows.

224-654-1772-3147.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

997-1793-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1793-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

565-1434-2450-6203.manaNeeded: {2}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
565-1434-2450-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Throne of Eldraine.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as its color as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
565-1434-2450-6203.notes: Once you have infinite mana to cast Whim of Volrath, you can either name different colors, draw cards instead, and/or target other permanents.

2167-5626-5671-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5626-5671-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1308-2060-3490-3910-4017.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
1308-2060-3490-3910-4017.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1636-2857-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-5241.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying {2}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Sakashima's Student.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Sakashima's Student to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

1069-1475-2034.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one Equipment.
You control at least one additional creature.
1069-1475-2034.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to any creature you control except Puresteel Paladin or the creature that has One with the Kami attached.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with the Equipment attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Repeat.

974-2487-2816-3008.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Flamewright does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Flamewright.
974-2487-2816-3008.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Flamewright's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Construct creature token.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the Construct token.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the Construct to become a copy of Smaug for as long as Blade of Shared Souls is attached to it.
Put the Construct token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Construct dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Activate Flamewright by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may simply tap and untap Flamewright to get infinite Construct tokens, and then use its second ability to sacrifice them for infinite damage.

3591-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power.
3591-4567.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

2034-3263-4082-4763.notablePrerequisites: Kemba has at least one Equipment attached.
2034-3263-4082-4763.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kemba, adding {C}{C}.
Kemba dies, triggering Koll, returning Kemba from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kemba by paying {2}.
Kemba enters the battlefield, attaching any Equipment you control to it.
Repeat.

618-643-3320.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goatnapper with haste.
The Goatnapper token enters the battlefield, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1331-1495-2313.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1331-1495-2313.description:
If Triskelion has more than 3 +1/+1 counters on it, activate Trislekion by removing all additional counters to deal damage to your choice of targets.
Activate Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 1 an additional 2 times, killing Triskelion.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Triskelion to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Repeat.

3554-3617-4582.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
3554-3617-4582.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Beseech the Queen by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Beseech the Queen and Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
